findings.summary: Luna omitted current official Lunch, Kids, and EAT 250 menu surfaces; it also failed to fully enumerate Dessert, which is accessible as official HTML.

No complete restaurant-issued allergen matrix or cross-contact disclosure was located. Current menu descriptions can support only narrow named-ingredient positives, never complete arrays or negatives.
The restaurant-linked MyCheckApp ordering catalog remains unenumerated and retains restaurant_linked_vendor authority.

verifier.summary: Independent verification confirms Barrel & Bushel Tysons identity and verifies every Luna surface and current product once. Luna missed Lunch, Kids, EAT 250, and accessible Dessert enumeration. All 94 frozen auditItemKeys are reconciled exactly once; Tomatoes & Burrata was added to the Lunch exact-match group. Allergen and cross-contact evidence remains unavailable beyond narrow named-ingredient positives, and the linked vendor plus beverage PDF keep the work low confidence.
